About Organization

The Delhi High Court is the highest court in the Indian state of Delhi. It was established in 1966.

The court has jurisdiction over the National Capital Territory of Delhi.

About the Programme

The Delhi High Court Higher Judicial Service Exam 2026 is a government job opportunity for law graduates.

The exam is conducted by the Delhi High Court to recruit candidates for the Higher Judicial Service.
